يقترضن (form VIII)

# يُقْتَرَضْنَ (yuqtaraḍna) /juq.ta.radˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
